versions.content: When J1939Rm_RxIndication is called by the PDU Router to indicate reception of an acknowledgement which matches a pending request Specification of a Request Manager for SAE J1939 AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 21 of 87 Document ID 611 : AUTOSAR_SWS_SAEJ1939RequestManager - AUTOSAR confidential - (acknowledged PGN, source address, acknowledged address), the J 1939 Request Manager shall call the <User> _AckIndication or the service port function corresponding to the stored user ID.

When J1939Rm_RxIndication is called by the PDU Router to indicate reception of an acknowledgement which matches a pending request Specification of a Request Manager for SAE J1939 AUTOSAR CP R20 - 11 21 of 88 Document ID 611 : AUTOSAR_SWS_SAEJ1939RequestManager (acknowledged PGN, source address, acknowledged address), the J 1939 Request Manager shall call the <User> _AckIndication or the service port function corresponding to the stored user ID.

When J1939Rm_RxIndication is called by the PDU Router to indicate reception of an acknowledgement which matches a pending re- quest (acknowledged PGN , source address , acknowledged address), the J1939 Request Manager shall call the User_AckIndication or the service port function corresponding to the stored user ID.
